slides.label: In the sky now
slides.title: Jupiter in Leo
slides.subtitle: The teacher walks into the king's palace
slides.note: 31 Oct to 24 Jan, then 25 Jun to 26 Nov 2027

slides.label: Who and where
slides.title: The teacher and the palace
slides.closing:
In Nadi, Jupiter is jiva, the life in you:
where he walks, your year grows

slides.label: Where he's coming from
slides.title: The auditor's homework
body:
Since June the teacher lived in Cancer,
the mother's house, where he is strongest

There he worked hand in hand with the auditor
(Saturn in Pisces): same element, so in Nadi
they act as one
He walks into Leo carrying that homework
slides.closing:
What you built with discipline
now wants a stage
slides.after: They stay linked into 2027: in step again 3 Apr and 11 Jul

slides.label: The rest of the cast
slides.title: Who's in the palace

items.label: Ketu · same room
items.head: The monk
items.line:
Already inside, in his own star;
they meet exactly on 11 Nov

items.label: Mars · just behind
items.head: The soldier
items.line:
Tired, walks in on 12 Nov;
all three together 13 to 16 Nov

items.label: Rahu · Saturn · facing
items.head: The magician and the auditor
items.line:
Across the room: hype and audit,
until early December

items.label: Sun · the owner
items.head: The king
items.line:
Away in Libra and weak; moves into
the teacher's house on 16 Dec

slides.note: Graha: Sanskrit for “the one who grabs”

slides.label: 16 Dec to 14 Jan
slides.title:
The king and the teacher
swap houses
body:
The king (Sun) moves into the teacher's house
while the teacher sits in the king's

A swap like this ties two grahas
together like business partners

Power listens to wisdom; mentors get authority;
fathers and children make peace
slides.closing:
Ask a mentor to vouch for you
in late December

slides.label: The calendar
slides.title: Key dates
items: The soldier joins: all three together
The king and the teacher swap houses
Back to Cancer for old lessons
Returns for the long stay, to 26 Nov 2027

slides.label: What to expect
slides.title: What changes
items: Coaches, advisors and real experts get heard

With the king away, bosses and governments
face experts, courts and banks

Fake gurus and quick-money schemes
get exposed by early December

Pregnancies, school choices, creative launches,
mostly after 13 Nov

slides.label: How to live it
slides.title: Day to day
items:
Once a week, share what you know:
a post, a talk, a lesson
One mentor call a month; help one junior
A teacher on a throne can turn into a lecturer

Leo rules the heart: a daily walk,
lighter late dinners

slides.title:
Which room is he
walking into for you?
slides.subtitle: Find Leo in your chart
